text: dsh-web-search-tavily 是面向 DSH web 客户端的网页搜索插件：它向 ctx.web 注册 Tavily 搜索提供者，并通过 search-switch 按 web-search 设置选择 Tavily 或 DeepSeek 官方搜索后端。主要功能包括调用 Tavily 搜索接口、把结果整理为链接与摘要、在设置中切换搜索后端，以及限制每次搜索的结果数。适合需要让 DSH 助手检索网页信息的用户。使用 Tavily 后端需要配置 TAVILY_API_KEY，搜索查询会发送到 api.tavily.com。

dsh-web-search-tavily adds Tavily search to DSH and routes requests through a settings based provider switch. It returns source links and snippets and lets users choose Tavily or DeepSeek official search. Tavily searches require TAVILY_API_KEY and send queries to api.tavily.com.

dsh-web-search-tavily 的功能「Tavily 网页搜索」：通过 DSH 的 web 搜索提供者调用 Tavily，传入用户查询并返回规范化的链接、标题、摘要和发布日期。
dsh-web-search-tavily 的功能「搜索后端切换」：search-switch 每次搜索读取 web-search 设置，并把请求委派给所选且可用的提供者。
dsh-web-search-tavily 的功能「搜索结果数量设置」：web-search-tavily 配置的 maxResults 设置每次搜索请求的最大结果数，默认值为 5。
dsh-web-search-tavily 使用 Tavily 后端时会将搜索查询发送到 api.tavily.com，并通过 Bearer 凭据认证；使用前需提供可解析的 TAVILY_API_KEY。

dsh-web-search-tavily README · dsh-web-search-tavily：A Tavily-backed search provider **bundle** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`). It registers a Tavily backend for the `ctx.web` web-search seam and ships a **hot-switchable backend selector** (Tavily / DeepSeek search).

dsh-web-search-tavily README · Features：- **Tavily provider** — calls `POST /search` and normalizes results to `{ url, title, snippet, publishedAt }`. Tavily returns content excerpts, so the model can quote snippets directly.
- **Hot backend switcher** — a delegating provider (`search-switch`) sits behind the `web` row and resolves the active backend from the `web-search` settings section on every search. **Saving the section takes effect immediately: no restart, no loader-row reload.**
- Full `WebError` taxonomy (`WEB_PROVIDER_ERROR` / `WEB_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_MISSING` / `WEB_ABORTED`).
- Credential resolution chain: literal `apiKey` → `credentials` service → launch environment.
- Settings sections:
  - `web-search-tavily` — `apiKey` / `apiKeyEnv` / `baseURL` / `maxResults`
  - `web-search` — `backend` selection (`tavily` | `deepseek-official`)

Restart `dsh web` after installing (bundle layers are frozen at boot). To uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-web-search-tavily`.

dsh-web-search-tavily README · 1. Credential：Store your Tavily key in `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`:

```yaml
TAVILY_API_KEY: tvly-your-key
```

dsh-web-search-tavily README · 2. Backend selection：The `web` row's `searchProvider` is set to `search-switch` (the delegating provider) by this bundle. The active backend lives in the `web-search` section of `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml` and **hot-reloads on save**:

```yaml
web-search:
  backend: tavily            # tavily | deepseek-official
```

dsh-web-search-tavily README · 2. Backend selection：- `tavily` — this plugin's Tavily provider (results carry content excerpts)
- `deepseek-official` — delegates to the shipped `web-search-deepseek` provider (DeepSeek Anthropic-compatible Messages endpoint; no excerpts)

dsh-web-search-tavily README · 3. Tavily options (`web-search-tavily` section)：| Field | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | none | Literal key (secret, stored via the credentials domain) |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `TAVILY_API_KEY` | Credential reference name |
| `baseURL` | `https://api.tavily.com` | Tavily REST endpoint |
| `maxResults` | `5` | Max results per search |

dsh-web-search-tavily README · How it works：```
web_search tool → ctx.web (searchProvider: search-switch)
  → switcher delegates by web-search.backend:
      tavily            → this plugin's provider → POST https://api.tavily.com/search
      deepseek-official → shipped provider       → Anthropic Messages + web_search_20250305

dsh-web-search-tavily README · How it works：Why a delegating provider instead of editing the `web` row directly? Changing the `web` row's config **restarts the dsh-web plugin and disposes every registered provider** (Cordis `Fiber.update → restart` semantics). The switcher keeps the selection in the settings layer only, sidestepping that hazard entirely.
